variant_note: Extended-range JASSM: same external dimensions as the AGM-158A (USAF), turbofan instead of turbojet and a larger fuel volume. Kept out of docs/design/units/units/ because the unit catalog schema (tools/unit_catalog/unit.schema.json) only allows classes from classes.json and mobility tracked/wheeled/foot.
notes: Stealthy air-launched cruise missile; Poland's F-16C/D Block 52+ carry it. Wings, fin and intake scoop fold while carried and deploy after release; the model shows the deployed flight shape. No reference image stored yet: the compare loop used the agent's knowledge of published photographs (Commons category 'AGM-158 JASSM'); the human may add a side / top view as side_1.png / top_1.png.

sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AGM-158_JASSM (length 4.287 m, width 550 mm (B: 635 mm), height 450 mm, span 2.7 m for the B)
https://missilethreat.csis.org/missile/jassm/ (4.26 m long, 0.55 m wide, 0.45 m high, 2.7 m extended span)
width = deployed span 2.4 m as in TASK-144 (sources disagree: 2.4 vs 2.7 m); height = body 0.45 m + deployed fin, estimated from photographs (uncertain)

silhouette_features: Faceted, box-like stealth body with a trapezoid section: flat belly, chines low on the sides, narrower flat top
Flat, chined wedge nose: the top slopes down to a low tip, seeker window on the upper nose
Small swept wing mounted on top of the body just aft of the middle (deployed after release)
Single swept vertical fin on top of the tail
Air intake scoop under the rear half of the body, short tapered boat tail with the exhaust
details: Dark imaging infrared seeker window on the nose
skip: Folded carriage configuration (the turntable shows the flight shape)
camo_note: Matte olive-grey / grey radar-absorbent finish, no national markings visible at turntable scale.
